terms.definition: Mass per unit volume: ρ = m / V.
terms.examiner: Units kg/m³. Gases have low density because particles are far apart.

terms.definition: Melting, freezing, boiling, evaporating, condensing and sublimating; mass is conserved.
terms.examiner: Changes of state are physical: the material recovers its original properties.

terms.definition: Solids: particles close, regular, vibrate. Liquids: close, random, move past each other. Gases: far apart, random, fast.
